item.title: Eagle Scout achievement
item.description: Brennan Huber, 18, of Clifton Twp., the son of Timothy and Jennifer Huber, has earned the rank of Eagle Scout, the highest honor in Scouting. For his Eagle Scout service project, Brennan led the effort to uncover, raise and relevel historic tombstones at the Moscow Cemetery, helping preserve the cemetery’s appearance and honor those laid to rest there.
